criteria.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-core (run_pin_tests.rs) dispatches a study job whose head holds studies/<id>/pin.json with a repository_url matching the configured repo_url and a sha differing from what repo_ref ("main") resolves to. It asserts the pinner is asked for that sha, and the job record's pin sha equals it. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria.evidence: an_existing_studys_pin_overrides_the_configured_ref commits studies/demo/pin.json (URL, STUDY_SHA), the configured ref resolves to FAKE_SHA, and the test asserts pinner.requests() == [(URL, STUDY_SHA)] and the committed job.json pin sha == STUDY_SHA. Passed when I ran it.

criteria.criterion: Tests cover the fallbacks: with no existing study for the repository the configured repo_ref is used as before; with several studies for one repository, the one whose id the request names is chosen, and if none is named the behavior is documented and never silently picks a different commit. Run: cargo test.
criteria.evidence: a_study_of_another_repository_leaves_the_configured_ref_in_force asserts the pinner gets (URL, REF) and the record holds FAKE_SHA. The existing tests (for example a_study_pins_once_...) cover the case with no studies at all. with_several_studies_of_one_repository_the_request_names_the_one_to_pin shows that naming 'beta' pins beta's sha, and that naming none or both errors with 'several studies' and pinner.count()==0. The behavior is documented in the pin_repo doc comment, in CHANGELOG and in D102. All passed.

criteria.criterion: A pin.json whose sha is not a full 40-hex id, or whose pin does not resolve to that same sha, stops the job before dispatch with a message naming the study, rather than falling back to main. Run: cargo test.
criteria.evidence: a_pin_that_is_not_a_full_sha_or_does_not_resolve_to_itself_stops_the_job_naming_the_study checks that the shas 'main' and '6407052f' each error with 'study demo' and '40-hex', with pinner.count()==0. For a pinner that resolves to a different sha, the error names 'study demo' and STUDY_SHA, and HEAD does not change. Passed.

criteria.evidence: The diff shows that the pin_repo doc comment and the CHANGELOG 'Fixed' entry each state 'an existing study's studies/<id>/pin.json overrides repo_ref; athena.toml's repo_ref is used only for a new study'. Both name job 20261015-201650-cyvb, fc8972cd and 6407052f.

criteria.criterion: No file under studies/, athena.toml or defaults.toml is changed; re-pinning or re-citing the study is a separate user decision.

findings.summary: The request names a study id if the id appears anywhere in the text, so a short id can match by accident
findings.evidence: study_pin filters with request.contains(study.as_str()). With studies 'demo' and 'demo-2', a request naming 'demo-2' also contains 'demo', so the job stops as ambiguous. A request containing 'alphabet' would select a study named 'alpha'. The job fails safe or picks a study the user nearly named, so no commit is silently wrong, but matching on word boundaries would be more precise.

findings.summary: A malformed pin.json for any repository stops every study job
findings.evidence: study_pin parses each studies/*/pin.json as JSON before it compares repository_url, so invalid JSON in the pin of an unrelated study makes the job fail with an error.

findings.summary: A new study of a repository that already has one study is pinned to the old study's commit
findings.evidence: When exactly one study matches the URL it is used no matter what the request says, so a new topic on the same repository reads the old sha. This follows the accepted reading's assumption and is documented in D102's tradeoff only implicitly.

summary: The change passes. Before this change, the pinning step resolved only athena.toml's repo_ref ("main") and never read the study's pin.json; the fix is made there. Study jobs now read studies/*/pin.json from the committed head, and a study whose repository_url matches the configured repo_url pins that exact sha. If the pin resolves to a different commit, or its sha is not a full 40-hex id, the job stops before dispatch with a message naming the study. It never falls back to main. With several studies for one repository, the request must name exactly one study id, or the job stops. The real studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json names the same repository URL that athena.toml configures, so the real case is covered. I ran fmt, clippy and the full test suite in the snapshot and all pass, including the four new tests. Each new test asserts which sha the pinner is asked for and what the job record holds. The pin_repo doc comment, the CHANGELOG entry and decision D102 state the rule and name the cause (job 20261015-201650-cyvb mounted fc8972cd while the pin said 6407052f). Every changed file is on the expected deliverables list, and nothing under studies/ or the toml files changed. I found two minor issues: the study id is matched as a substring of the request, and a malformed pin.json for an unrelated repository stops every study job.
